blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Harbour Place home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Harbour Place?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 7 houses listed in Harbour Place. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Harbour Place from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses and 0 condos and townhomes sold in Harbour Place over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 2 sold.

faq.q: How big is Harbour Place compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Harbour Place held 1.6% of the 425 detached houses listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Harbour Place than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses rose from 4 in June to 7 in September 2026 (+75.0%).

faq.q: What did houses in Harbour Place sell for?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in Harbour Place between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,000,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Harbour Place?
faq.a: The median was 25 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.9% of the last list price (14% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
